# certloom_agent (Data Source)

Looks up an enrolled agent by name. Agents enroll themselves with a one-time token; they are not created by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "certloom_agent" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `health` (String) Liveness from the last heartbeat.
- `hostname` (String) Host name the agent reported.
- `id` (String) Identifier.
- `state` (String) `active` or `revoked`.
